notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2c
notes.notes:
This patch aims to address some further reported issues. Thank you to player Oriadas for reporting.

This patch corrects the following:

Balance Changes:

• Cedrics ability 'Apply Pressure' can now be used outside of battle.
• Bandages, Anti Toxin and Remedy Brew now treat both enemy inflicted states
and player inflicted states.
• Apply Pressure now treats all versions of Bleeding.

Fixes:

• The Remedy brew has had it's description updated to reflect it does not
treat open wounds. Removed incorrect player inflicted bleed treatment.
• Fixed text display issues for some Steal related texts in the player Journal.
• Corrected AP text in Journal incorrectly referencing TP.
• Fixed 'Exorcism' achievement not being rewarded.
• Typos corrected at the Monument of Govel.

notes.title: Hotfix to 1.0.2b
notes.notes: [p]This is a minor hotfix that aims to address an issue where the battles with Frosty were not ending correctly. [/p][p]The discord link in game has also been updated.[/p][p]A crash has been fixed in the 'Dark Depths' region.[/p]

notes.title: 1.0.2a Hotfix
notes.notes:
This is a small hotfix to fix game crashes related to the Chime2.ogg file being missing. 

The Arach Guild skill shop has also been updated to display missing requirements for skills that are locked to the player.

Increases the brightness during the Wraith boss battle in the Darkest Dungeon.

notes.title: Another Realm 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995316/4729fd253bfde8957554d52a9e7ea035c88df545.png[/img][list]
[*] You can now track up to 2 quests on the map scene. In the Quest Menu, when you now 'Track' (previously named Pin) a quest, it will display the objectives on the map scene. No more jumping back and forth on the menu to see what needs doing! 

[*] The quest tracker can be enabled and disabled from the Options menu, under the User Interface (UI) category.

[*] Removed 'Difficulty' display for quests since this was not used for the majority of quests. 

[*] Updated the introduction text in relation to Quest tracking towards the game start.

[/list]
